summary.text: The largest LGA in Benue by population and the seat of the Tor Tiv, whose palace is in the heart of the town.

languageUse.text: Tiv, Hausa and English are the most widely spoken languages in Gboko.

history.text: The ancestral headquarters of the Tiv. In March 2017 James Ayatse was crowned Tor Tiv V at the J. S. Tarka Stadium in Gboko.

livelihoods.text: Farming (rice, yams, maize, cassava), cement (the former Benue Cement Company, now Dangote Cement), limestone and other minerals, and trade at the Ortese, Ikpa and Tarukpe markets.
